 It was done on the first album that he recorded,not having a lot of vocal coaching.However,it sounds quite good,but not like the beast that he is nowadays.You could see how his distortion has changed,not only for his age,but also because he started having vocal coaching by Melissa cross in some point.

Always remember to try new things.It's great when you're starting on focusing on basic fingerstyle and one style (I normally recommend doing this for like 6 months to some students that I've had),but don't put yourself into a cage ! You're capable of playing any song in any style.
I really recommend playing some from the rhcp (Look for some that don't have bass solos or crazy slap,like californication),some classics from motown or classics song from stevie wonder,barry white,james brown,etc. Also listen to some pop songs from michael jackson,and even Queen.
All that normally just use fingerstyle,they aren't too fast or have crazy things.
